modules.name: European Expansion
modules.note: Use the green side of the goal board; some new goals don't work on the blue side.

modules.name: Oceania Expansion
modules.note: Nectar is a wild food; unspent nectar is discarded at the end of each round.

modules.name: Wingspan Asia (Flock mode)
modules.note: Adds 6-7 players in two groups; also mixes in Asia's birds and bonus cards.

steps.text: Shuffle together the bird decks you want to use
steps.note: Each expansion's birds also work on their own with the base game

steps.text: Shuffle the European birds and bonus cards into their decks; mix in the extra eggs, food and goal tiles
Mix Oceania's bonus cards and goal tiles in with the others
Shuffle in the Americas birds, bonus cards and goal tiles
Shuffle in Asia's birds and bonus cards (not the Duet goal tiles with red corners)
Shuffle the bird deck beside the bird tray; fill the tray with {n} faceup birds
All food and egg tokens in the supply
Add the nectar tokens to the food supply
Toss the food dice into the birdfeeder
Swap all 5 food dice for Oceania's 5 dice and toss them into the birdfeeder
Goal board: green side (1st/2nd/3rd place) or blue side (1 point per item)

Expansion reference tile next to the goal board

steps.note: Combine enough bird cards from the base game and expansions

steps.text: Each group gets its own birdfeeder with {n}

{n} hummingbird faceup on each of the 5 garden spaces

End-of-round Goal Scoring card, Round 1 up, beside the Round 1 goal

Each player: an Oceania player mat and {n} action cubes of one color

Keep 1 bonus card, discard the other
